# Extract away team scores and convert to numeric values
# The score format is like "9.11 (65)" where the number in parentheses is the total points
# We need to extract the total points (the number inside parentheses) for comparison
df['away_total'] = df['away team score'].str.extract(r'\((\d+)\)').astype(int)

# Count total number of away teams (each row is a unique away team appearance)
total_away_teams = df['away team'].nunique()

# Count number of away teams with total score > 10
# First, get away teams that had a score > 10 in any of their games
away_teams_gt_10 = df[df['away_total'] > 10]['away team'].unique()
count_away_teams_gt_10 = len(away_teams_gt_10)

# Check if 1/3 of away teams had score > 10
# Using exact comparison with floating point tolerance
answer = abs(count_away_teams_gt_10 / total_away_teams - 1/3) < 1e-10
